title: KNOW YOUR PAD
why: J7: guests could not tell which pad belonged to their window when it connected or came back.
now: Claiming a pad gives that pad a 250 ms pulse and puts p1 in amber or p2 in cyan beside its pillager for two seconds. First pad stays p2 and second stays p1.

edits.replacement:
padClaimPoll(gp); // v28.xx (cw-cx-padowner): claim before the reconnect pause consumes this poll.
  if(padLostPoll(gp)){ RUMBLE.gp=null; return; }

edits.anchor: if(m.t==='rumble'){ if(!RUMBLE.other) return 'nopad'; return padRumbleOn(RUMBLE.other,+m.s||0,+m.ms||0)?'rumble':'nopad'; }   // v17.37: a buzz the other window asked for, on the pad this window reads for him
